raw.title: Julius Evola
raw.extract: Giulio Cesare Andrea Evola, better known as Julius Evola, was an Italian philosopher and writer, who espoused traditionalist, aristocratic, martial and imperialist values. An esoteric thinker in Fascist Italy, he also had ties to Nazi Germany. In the post-war era, he was an ideological mentor of Italian militant neo-fascist movements.
